_meta.scopeNote: Provider-published milestones for public cloud launch, developer/free access, and U.S. government or regulated availability. These are historical references, not feature-parity claims, procurement advice, or compliance approval.

history.title: Amazon S3 starts AWS public cloud storage
history.summary: AWS announced Amazon S3 as internet-scale storage for developers, establishing one of the earliest public AWS cloud services.
history.sourceLabel: AWS What's New - Announcing Amazon S3

history.title: AWS Free Usage Tier launches
history.summary: AWS states that the Free Usage Tier launched in December 2010, giving individual builders a low-friction way to learn and prototype.
history.sourceLabel: AWS News Blog - Free Usage Tier reference

history.title: AWS GovCloud (US) launches
history.summary: AWS launched a U.S. government region for federal, state, local, and contractor workloads with specific regulatory requirements.
history.sourceLabel: AWS News Blog - New AWS GovCloud (US) Region

history.title: Windows Azure and SQL Azure reach general availability
history.summary: Microsoft announced production availability for Windows Azure and SQL Azure with SLAs, marking Azure's commercial cloud entry.
history.sourceLabel: Official Microsoft Blog - Windows Azure General Availability

history.title: Azure free account adds broader learn-and-explore access
history.summary: Microsoft described the new Azure free account with a credit, 12 months of popular free services, and always-free services for learners and builders.
history.sourceLabel: Microsoft Azure Blog - Last week in Azure

history.title: Microsoft Azure Government reaches U.S. general availability
history.summary: Microsoft announced Azure Government as a community cloud platform for U.S. state, local, and federal government agencies.
history.sourceLabel: Microsoft Source - Azure Government general availability

history.title: Google App Engine preview launches
history.summary: Google launched App Engine preview as a developer platform for running applications on Google's infrastructure, with free quotas and planned paid scale.
history.sourceLabel: Google Cloud Platform Blog - Introducing Google App Engine

history.title: Google Cloud expands Free Tier and Always Free products
history.summary: Google Cloud announced an improved free tier, including an extended trial and non-expiring Always Free product usage limits.
history.sourceLabel: Google Cloud Blog - Your next home in the cloud

history.title: Google Cloud Platform receives FedRAMP High authorization
history.summary: Google Cloud announced FedRAMP High authorization for 17 GCP products and expanded FedRAMP Moderate coverage, strengthening U.S. government and public sector workload evidence.
history.sourceLabel: Google Cloud Blog - GCP FedRAMP High authorized

history.title: Oracle Bare Metal Cloud Services become generally available
history.summary: Oracle announced general availability of Bare Metal Cloud Services with compute, storage, identity, networking, and pay-for-what-you-use billing.
history.sourceLabel: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Blog - Bare Metal Cloud Services

history.title: Oracle Cloud Free Tier launches
history.summary: Oracle announced Always Free services and a trial credit for developers, students, educators, and organizations to learn and build on OCI.
history.sourceLabel: Oracle Press Release - Oracle Cloud Free Tier

history.title: OCI Government regions achieve FedRAMP authorization
history.summary: Oracle announced FedRAMP authorization for government regions dedicated to U.S. public sector organizations, including federal, state, and local entities.
history.sourceLabel: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Blog - FedRAMP-authorized government regions
